transformation: spec.json preserves upstream prompts/options. signatures.json extracts closed-set shapes, member order and all function defaults from trader.py annotations, replacing Python reflection. Dispatcher read/decision aggregation is ported to TypeScript tasks and a bounded map with a presence branch. Authored commands and synthetic answers are not cached inference or published measurements. Only proposes calls; omits Call.run(), market bars, charts and external effects. No usage is fabricated.
questionContractMethod: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted compact JSON from pinned dispatch.py all_questions(), executed with trader.py signature-only stubs; preserves numeric-string option keys lexicographically.
